last.summary: The BWT spec covers sorted cyclic rotations, the last column, valid origPtr positions, and both decoder-style and declarative inverses, including periodic examples. I checked the forward last-column and origPtr construction, 24-bit header write, both decoder bounds checks and block limit, cftab/tt mapping, and BZ_GET_FAST walk against the vendored C source. The changed files stay within scope, and verify.sh passes (build, source checks, and lake test).
